audit.whatIsWrong: Two errors. (1) The page calls the root 'Tangle-Barbs (Q)' and 'Q root' throughout — Tangle-Barbs is her E (1000 range, 12/11.5/11/10.5/10); her Q is Blooming Burst (800 range, 9s), which has no CC. (2) The page says to sidestep the root 'behind minions', but Riot's text says the tangle roots everything it passes through and grows larger and longer-rooting after passing a champion — minions do not stop it.
audit.why: A player told to hide behind the wave from Tangle-Barbs gets rooted anyway, and one told to watch her Q watches the wrong button entirely. Both errors point the player at the wrong defence for the ability that decides the matchup.

notes: packet.defects flagged wants.foe[1] 'Use Shapesplitter clone to dodge your execute' as a probable wrong name — that is a FALSE POSITIVE. Shapesplitter is the correct name of her W per the kit file, so I left the line alone. The real name error in this page was the slot letter on Tangle-Barbs, which the defect scan did not catch. Pop Blossom's preparation is hidden while she is disguised (Inherent Glamour), which is why the level-6 'execute her mid-channel' line should not be read as a guaranteed tell — I did not add a claim either way about whether damage interrupts the preparation, since Riot's text does not say.
